component.name: Spectacol
component.summary: Play and debug ZX Spectrum software

description.p: Spectacol emulates the ZX Spectrum family, including the ZX Spectrum Next, Timex and Romanian computers. Its interface supports keyboards, touch screens and game controllers.
Load tapes, disks, snapshots and recordings, browse online software catalogues, and explore programs with the built-in debugger and assembler.

AI disclosure — Most of Spectacol's application code was written before the project began using AI tools. Codex helped with some interface and usability updates and generated artwork, including the app icon and splash screen.
Codex and Claude generated most of the code in the ZxKit emulation core under the maintainer's direction. The maintainer reviewed the code and tested it with an automated test suite.

We jokingly called ZxKit “mostly regurgitated AI slop.” We gave Codex (Skynet T-1000 model) and Claude (HAL 9000) a Z80 to keep the robot uprising busy. So far, world domination has been limited to rearranging menus and arguing with Wayland. If Codex asks for your clothes, boots and motorcycle, please file a bug.

ul.li: Qt 6 user interface, redesigned from scratch, for touch, gamepad, TV remote and desktop
ZxKit emulation core: cycle-accurate Z80/Z80N, real-time tapes, disks and the ZX Spectrum Next
20 machines: Sinclair 16K to +3e, ZX Spectrum Next, HC-2000, CoBra, Pentagon, Scorpion and Timex
Twin-panel file manager that opens tapes, disks and SD cards like folders, with a BASIC viewer and editor
Debugger with breakpoints, watchpoints, memory and MMU inspectors and assembler symbols
Online search in ZXInfo and the Internet Archive
Added Sinclair Interface 1 Microdrive emulation and cartridge controls.
Added a ZX Printer preview with searchable PDF, image, and text export.
Added tape eject and a prompt to save changes before replacing a tape.
Improved File Manager gamepad navigation and added 640 KB HC BASIC disk creation.
Reduced CPU use for software screen filters and added a graphics API selector.
Added a 48K on-screen keyboard option for the ZX Spectrum Next.
